note: Literature links MAPK8IP3 to cerebral palsy mimics and hereditary spastic paraplegia panels, showing spasticity, intellectual disability, and cerebral/cerebellar volume loss/atrophy.

evidence.text: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with brain anomalies including cerebral or cerebellar atrophy, hypoplasia of the corpus callosum, and spasticity.

source.title: De novo variants in MAPK8IP3 cause intellectual disability with variable brain anomalies
source.quote: Brain anomalies such as perisylvian polymicrogyria, cerebral or cerebellar atrophy, and hypoplasia of the corpus callosum were consistent among individuals harboring recurrent de novo missense variants.

numbers.metric: unrelated individuals with de novo variants

evidence.text: Recurrent de novo MAPK8IP3 variants cause a core phenotype of spastic diplegia, intellectual disability, cerebral atrophy, and corpus callosum hypoplasia.

source.title: Recurrent de novo MAPK8IP3 variants cause neurological phenotypes
source.quote: The core phenotype includes spastic diplegia, intellectual disability, cerebral atrophy, and corpus callosum hypoplasia.
